leader.name: Joseph Stalin
leader.title: Chairman of the Council of Ministers

gdp_nominal.note: Western estimates put Soviet output at roughly a third of US output around 1949–50. Highly uncertain; will become a fogged range in Phase 3.

steel_output.note: Soviet official figure for 1949 crude steel output.

active_personnel.note: Soviet armed forces after post-war demobilisation, about 2.9 million in 1948 by later-published figures.

nuclear_warheads.note: No Soviet weapon exists yet. The first test (RDS-1) came in August 1949.

population.note: Back-projected from the official figure of about 178.5 million on 1 January 1950.

population_growth_annual.note: Rough post-war growth rate. A placeholder until the cohort-component model replaces it.
